CyclePhases.4: Umjikelezo wakho wesikhathi wakhiwe yizigaba eziningana, ngasinye sinendima ebalulekile ekulinganeni kwama-hormone akho nasempilweni yakho.
CyclePhases.10: Umjikelezo wakho ngokujwayelekile uhlukaniswe ngezigaba ezine eziyinhloko. Ubude bazo bungahluka phakathi kwabantu: umzimba ngamunye unesigqi sawo.
CyclePhases.20: Wonke owesifazane ahlukile: buka umzimba wakho bese ufunda isigqi sakho.
CyclePhases.21: Izinguquko zama-hormone zingathinta amandla akho, isimo sengqondo, ukulala, nemizwa ethile yomzimba phakathi nomjikelezo.
CyclePhases.23: Amandla akho angase abe phansi futhi umzimba wakho ungase udinge ukuphumula okwengeziwe.
CyclePhases.25: Amandla akhuphuka kancane kancane futhi ungase uzizwe unamandla kakhulu.
CyclePhases.27: Abanye besifazane bazwa amandla, isikhuthazo, nokuzethemba okwengeziwe.
CyclePhases.29: Ukukhathala, ukuvuvukala, noma izinguquko zesimo sengqondo kungavela.
CyclePhases.31: Akukho ndlela eyodwa kuphela yokuhlangabezana nesigaba ngasinye. Imizwa yakho siqu ihlala iyisiqondiso esingcono kakhulu.
CyclePhases.32: Ukwazi umjikelezo wakho kangcono kungakusiza ukulindela izikhathi ezithile futhi uqonde izinguquko ozibonayo nsuku zonke.
CyclePhases.34: Lindela isikhathi sakho nezigaba zaso ezahlukene
CyclePhases.36: Lungisa umsebenzi wakho ngokwezinga lamandla akho
CyclePhases.38: Nazi eminye imiphendulo yemibuzo evame ukubuzwa mayelana nezigaba ezahlukene zomjikelezo.
CyclePhases.39: Ingabe kujwayelekile ukuthi umjikelezo wami awuhlali izinsuku ezingama-28 ncamashi?
CyclePhases.40: Yebo. Ubude bomjikelezo bungahluka phakathi kwabantu, ngisho nakancane inyanga ngenyanga.
CyclePhases.41: Ingabe ukukhipha iqanda kwenzeka njalo ngosuku 14?
CyclePhases.42: Cha. Usuku 14 isilinganiso esivamile somjikelezo wezinsuku ezingama-28, kodwa ukukhipha iqanda kungenzeka kuqala noma kwenzeke kamuva.
CyclePhases.43: Kungani izimpawu zami zishintsha kuye ngesigaba?
CyclePhases.44: Izinguquko zama-hormone phakathi nomjikelezo zingathinta amandla, isimo sengqondo, ukulala, nemizwa ethile yomzimba.
CyclePhases.46: Yebo. Ukuzibhala njalo kungakusiza ukubona amaphethini akho futhi uqonde kangcono isigqi sakho.
CyclePhases.48: Uma ubuka kakhulu umjikelezo wakho, uqonda kakhulu ukuthi yini ejwayelekile kuwe.

CycleVitalSign.6: Kungani umjikelezo ngezinye izikhathi ubizwa ngokuthi “uphawu lwesihlanu lokuphila.”
CycleVitalSign.12: Ukulandelela umjikelezo wakho ukuze uzazi kangcono
CycleVitalSign.30: Umjikelezo wesikhathi uthonywa umsebenzi wama-hormone omzimba inyanga yonke. Ukufunda ukuwubuka kungakusiza uqonde kangcono ukuthi umzimba wakho usebenza kanjani, ngaphandle kokudinga ukuhlaziya yonke into ngokuningiliziwe.
CycleVitalSign.32: Awukho umjikelezo oyedwa ophelele: umzimba ngamunye unesigqi sawo, futhi lesi sigqi singahluka kancane inyanga ngenyanga. Umjikelezo ngokujwayelekile uthathwa njengojwayelekile uma uhlala phakathi kwezinsuku ezingama-21 nezingama-35, futhi izikhathi imvamisa zihlala izinsuku ezi-3 kuya kwezi-7.
CycleVitalSign.33: Lezi zibalo ziyizilinganiso: ukuhluka okuncane kuhlala kujwayelekile ngokuphelele, ikakhulukazi ngemva kokuthomba, ngemva kokubeletha, noma lapho i-menopause isondela.
CycleVitalSign.34: Ezinye izinguquko ziyafaneleka ukubukwa ngokucophelela okwengeziwe, njengalezi:
CycleVitalSign.41: Umjikelezo owodwa ongajwayelekile akusho ngokuzenzakalela ukuthi kunenkinga yempilo: umzimba ungaphendula okwesikhashana ezintweni eziningi ezahlukene.
CycleVitalSign.42: Lezi zinguquko ngezinye izikhathi zingahlobana nezizathu eziningana, ngaphandle kokuba yinkinga:
CycleVitalSign.43: Lezi ziyizincazelo ezimbalwa ezingaba khona phakathi kwezinye: azithathi indawo yeseluleko sochwepheshe wezempilo.
CycleVitalSign.45: Ukubhala izinsuku zakho, ukuphuma kwegazi, noma indlela ozizwa ngayo kukusiza ukuzazi imikhuba yakho, inyanga ngenyanga.
CycleVitalSign.46: Usuku lokuqala lwesikhathi sakho, ubude baso, ukuphuma kwegazi, ubuhlungu, isimo sengqondo, amandla, noma uketshezi lwangasese yizo zonke izinto ongazibhala ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Inhloso akuyona ukuqhathanisa umjikelezo wakho nowomunye umuntu, kodwa ukubona kangcono okujwayelekile kuwe, nalokho okuhlukile kukho.
CycleVitalSign.47: Kujwayelekile ngokuphelele ukuba nemibuzo ngomjikelezo wakho. Ukufuna iseluleko sezokwelapha kungasiza ezimeni ezithile, isibonelo:
CycleVitalSign.54: Ukukhuluma nochwepheshe wezempilo kungakusiza uthole ukuthula noma, uma kudingeka, uthole ukwesekwa okufanele — akuyona isizathu sokukhathazeka ngokwayo.
CycleVitalSign.55: Umjikelezo awudingi ukuhleleka ngokuphelele ukuze ujwayelekile. Ukwazi isigqi sakho esijwayelekile imvamisa kuwusizo kakhulu kunokufuna ubude obufanelekile.
CycleVitalSign.56: Umjikelezo wakho wesikhathi ungomunye wezinkomba eziningi zempilo yakho. Ukuwulandelela njalo kungakusiza uqonde kangcono umzimba wakho futhi, ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ubone izinguquko ezidinga ukunakwa okukhethekile.
CycleVitalSign.57: Umjikelezo wakho, isinkombo esihle sempilo — AWA

ExerciseCycleSupport.6: Kungani ukuzivocavoca njalo kungasekela ukulingana komjikelezo wakho, ukunyakaza kwamuphi uhlobo okufanele kukhethwe, nokuthi ulungisa kanjani isivinini sakho ngaphandle kokucindezela noma icala.
ExerciseCycleSupport.7: Akukhona ngokwenza okuningi, kodwa ngokunyakaza ngendlela ekufanele nongayigcina ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.
ExerciseCycleSupport.18: Ukuzivocavoca njalo kuthinta izinhlelo eziningi zomzimba, kuhlanganise nalezo ezihilelekile ekulawuleni ama-hormone nasekusebenzeni komjikelezo wesikhathi. Kusebenza ikakhulukazi ekuzwiseni kwe-insulin, ekulawuleni ukucindezeleka, nasekusezingeni lokulala — izinto ezintathu ezisebenzisana nokulingana kwama-hormone.
ExerciseCycleSupport.19: Ukunyakaza njalo akuqinisekisi umjikelezo “ophelele”, kodwa kungomunye wemikhuba esekela impilo enhle ngokuphelele, nemiphumela engabonakala emjikelezweni kwabanye besifazane.
ExerciseCycleSupport.21: Ukuhlobana phakathi kokuzivocavoca nomjikelezo kuyaqondana nomuntu ngamunye: abanye besifazane babona imiphumela ecacile, abanye ngokuncane. Kunoma ikuphi, kuhlala kuyimikhuba enenzuzo.
ExerciseCycleSupport.22: Umsebenzi owenziwa njalo ungabeka isandla ezingeni eziningana, ngaphandle kokuthi le miphumela iqinisekisiwe noma ifane kuwo wonke umuntu:
ExerciseCycleSupport.29: Ukukhuthaza, kwabanye besifazane, umjikelezo ohleleke kangcono
ExerciseCycleSupport.30: Lezi zinzuzo ziyakhula kancane kancane: akuyona umphumela osheshayo ngemva kwesikhathi esisodwa.
ExerciseCycleSupport.31: Akukho msebenzi “ongcono” kunomunye: osebenza kangcono yilowo ozijabulisa ngokuwenza njalo.
ExerciseCycleSupport.38: Alikho ilungiselelo lomhlaba wonke: okubaluleke kakhulu ukuhleleka kunokusebenza kahle. Ukufaka ukunyakaza okufushane osukwini lwakho (ukuhamba, ukukhuphuka izitebhisi, ukuzelula) kubalwa njengesikhathi esihleliwe.
ExerciseCycleSupport.39: Izinga elifanele lincike ezingeni lakho lokulunga komzimba, empilweni yakho, emandleni akho ngaleso sikhathi, nasezinhlosweni zakho siqu: okusebenzela omunye akusebenzeli omunye ngempela.
ExerciseCycleSupport.41: Izikhathi ezintathu ezimfushane ngeviki, ezigcinwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imvamisa zinenzuzo eningi kunenhloso enkulu elahlwa ngemva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa.
ExerciseCycleSupport.42: Amandla nokukhululeka komzimba kungahluka phakathi nomjikelezo. Ukulungisa izinga lomsebenzi wakho ngokwendlela ozizwa ngayo kuvumelekile ngokuphelele.
ExerciseCycleSupport.43: Ngesikhathi sakho: ukunyakaza okuthambile uma kukufanele
ExerciseCycleSupport.44: Ngemva kwesikhathi sakho: khuphula kancane kancane uma amandla akho evuma
ExerciseCycleSupport.45: Cishe ngesikhathi sokukhipha iqanda: qhubeka nomsebenzi ojwayelekile ngokwendlela ozizwa ngayo
ExerciseCycleSupport.46: Ngaphambi kwesikhathi sakho: khetha ukunyakaza okusindwa kalula, uphumule uma kudingeka
ExerciseCycleSupport.47: Lena akuyona imithetho eqinile yomzimba: owesifazane ngamunye uhlangabezana nomjikelezo wakhe ngendlela eyahlukile, futhi lezi zibonelo ziyizindawo zokubheka, hhayi izibopho.
ExerciseCycleSupport.48: Kwabesifazane abane-PCOS, ukuzivocavoca njalo kungasiza kakhulu: kusekela ukuzwisa kwe-insulin, indlela evame ukuthinteka kulesi simo, futhi kungabeka isandla ekulinganeni okungcono kwe-metabolic nokwama-hormone isikhathi eside.
ExerciseCycleSupport.50: Lokhu akuyona indlela yokwelapha, kodwa ukwesekwa okuhlanganisayo ekunakekelweni okuphelele, okufanele kulungiswe nochwepheshe wezempilo.
ExerciseCycleSupport.51: Ezinye izinkolelo ezingalungile noma imikhuba ingenza ubuhlungu kunokuba isize:
ExerciseCycleSupport.53: Ukucabanga ukuthi kuyasiza kuphela ukuzivocavoca okunamandla
ExerciseCycleSupport.57: Ezimweni ezithile, iseluleko sochwepheshe wezempilo siwusizo ikakhulukazi ngaphambi kokuqala kabusha noma ukulungisa umsebenzi wokuzivocavoca:
ExerciseCycleSupport.63: Ukuqala kabusha umsebenzi ngemva kokukhulelwa noma ukubeletha
ExerciseCycleSupport.64: Noma yisiphi isimo lapho umsebenzi uvinjelwe ngokwezokwelapha
ExerciseCycleSupport.66: Ukunyakaza akudingeki kube namandla noma kuphelele ukuze kube nenzuzo. Umsebenzi ojwayelekile, onenjabulo, nongagcinwa ungasekela impilo yakho iphelele futhi ubeke isandla, kwabanye besifazane, ekulawuleni kangcono umjikelezo.
ExerciseCycleSupport.68: Lesi sihloko senzelwe ulwazi jikelele futhi asithathi indawo yeseluleko sezokwelapha. Njalo lungisa ukuzivocavoca ngokwesimo sakho siqu, futhi ucele iseluleko kuchwepheshe wezempilo uma unokungabaza.
ExerciseCycleSupport.69: Nyakaza ukuze usekele umjikelezo wakho — AWA

FastingQadaa.6: Ukuthi nini nokuthi uzenzela kanjani izinsuku zokuzila ozishiyile, ngesivinini sakho nangaphandle kwecala.
FastingQadaa.8: Lokhu okuqukethwe kungokokufundisa kuphela. Imibuzo yenkolo kufanele iqinisekiswe ngabantu abafundile abafanelekile. I-AWA ayikhishi ama-fatwa noma izinqumo zenkolo ezikuphathelene wena.
FastingQadaa.14: I-Qadaa ichaza ukwenzela, kamuva, izinsuku zokuzila ezishiywe phakathi neRamadan — ikakhulukazi ngenxa yesikhathi. Lezi zinsuku kufanele zenzelwe ngoba ukuzila kweRamadan kuhlala kuyinsika yenyanga, futhi izinsuku ezimiswe ngenxa yesikhathi zibalwa njengezikweletwayo, ngaphandle kokuba yiphutha lakho.
FastingQadaa.15: Ukwenzela ngokujwayelekile kungaqala ngokushesha lapho iRamadan iphela, ngokushesha lapho isimo sakho sikuvumela. Ungazihlela lezi zinsuku ngesivinini sakho: abanye bakhetha ukuzihlanganisa maduze ngemva kweRamadan, kanti abanye bazihlakaza kancane kancane ezinyangeni ezilandelayo.
FastingQadaa.17: Ukwenzela izinsuku ngokulandelana noma ukuzihlakaza kungabukwa ngendlela ehlukile kuye ngesikole se-fiqh; akukho okunye kwalokhu okuboniswa lapha njengokuphela okuvumelekile.
FastingQadaa.18: Bhala inani lonke lezinsuku okufanele zenzelwe ngokushesha lapho iRamadan iphela
FastingQadaa.19: Khetha indlela elula: ikhalenda, uhlelo lokusebenza, incwadi yamanothi
FastingQadaa.21: Isibonelo, umuntu onezinsuku eziyi-6 zokwenzela angakhetha ukuzila usuku olulodwa ngeviki ngamaviki ayisithupha, noma azihlanganise esikhathini esifanayo uma kumfanele kangcono.
FastingQadaa.22: Kujwayelekile ukuzama ukwenzela izinsuku ezishiywe ngaphambi kweRamadan elandelayo. Lo mkhuba awuphoqelekile njalo kuzo zonke izimo, kodwa wenza ukuhlela kube lula futhi uvimbele ukuqongelela izinsuku eziningi ezisalindile.
FastingQadaa.24: Ukuhlakaza izinsuku zokwenzela ngokuya ngeshejuli yakho kukuvumela ukuthi uqhubeke ngokuthula, ngaphandle kokucindezela.
FastingQadaa.25: Ukuhlela kusenesikhathi kusiza ukugwema ukucindezeleka kwesikhashana sokugcina. Iseluleko esilula ukubala inani lezinsuku ezisele ngaphambi kweRamadan elandelayo bese uhlakaza izinsuku zokwenzela emaviki noma ezinyangeni ezikhona.
FastingQadaa.27: Uma isizathu esihlala isikhathi eside noma esibuyelelayo sikuvimbela ukuzila (isimo sempilo eside, isibonelo), isimo singase singene kwenye uhlaka; kuyasiza ikakhulukazi ukukhuluma ngaso nombhali ofanelekile onolwazi.
FastingQadaa.29: Imithetho enembile uma isikhathi sidlulwa ingahluka kuye ngencazelo. Kunoma yisiphi isimo esinzima, umbono wesazi sezenkolo esifanelekile uhlala uyisimiso.
FastingQadaa.30: Isibonelo, uma iRamadan elandelayo iqala ezinyangeni eziyi-8 futhi kusele izinsuku eziyi-6 zokwenzela, enye indlela ukuhlela cishe usuku olulodwa ngenyanga, kunokuguquguquka ngezimo ezingalindelekile.
FastingQadaa.31: Ukukhulelwa nokuncelisa ibele kungathinta ikhono lokuzila, ikakhulukazi lapho ukuzila kubeka ingozi empilweni kamama noma yengane. Impilo yomzimba nekhono langempela lokuzila yizinto ezibalulekile okufanele zicatshangelwe.
FastingQadaa.33: Lezi zimo ziqashelwa isiko lenkolo njengezingase zibangele ukukhululwa.
FastingQadaa.34: Imibono yenkolo mayelana nokuzila okungenziwanga ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa noma sokuncelisa ibele ingahluka kuye ngesikole, ikakhulukazi emibuzweni yokuthi ingabe ukwenzela okulula kwanele noma ukunxephezela nakho kuhilelekile. Isizathu esiqondile sokungazili nesimo somuntu siqu kungathinta impendulo esebenzayo.
FastingQadaa.36: I-Qadaa ikuvumela ukuthi wenzele izinsuku zokuzila ozishiyile ngokuthula, ngesivinini sakho. Esimweni esikhethekile (isikhathi esidlulile, ukukhulelwa, ukuncelisa ibele, isithiyo esihlala isikhathi eside), umbono wesazi sezenkolo esifanelekile uhlala uyisiphuzo esingcono kakhulu.

FertilityWindow.6: Kungani izinsuku ezizungeze ukukhipha iqanda zibaluleke kakhulu ekukhulelweni.
FertilityWindow.12: Isikhathi sokuzala sichaza isikhathi emjikelezweni wakho lapho ukukhulelwa kungenzeka khona. Sihlala cishe izinsuku eziyi-6: izinsuku ezi-5 ngaphambi kokukhipha iqanda, kanye nosuku lokukhipha iqanda ngokwalo.
FertilityWindow.14: Umjikelezo ngamunye uhlukile: isikhathi sokuzala asihlali njalo ngosuku lwekhalenda olufanayo inyanga nenyanga.
FertilityWindow.15: Isidoda singaphila kuze kube izinsuku ezi-5 emgudwini wokuzala, okukhulisa isikhathi lapho ukukhulelwa kungenzeka khona. Iqanda, ngakolunye uhlangothi, lihlala lingakhulelwa cishe amahora angama-24 kuphela ngemva kokukhishwa.
FertilityWindow.16: Isibonelo, ucansi olwenzeka izinsuku ezi-3 ngaphambi kokukhipha iqanda lungaholela ekukhulelweni, kanti ucansi ngosuku olulandela ukukhipha iqanda imvamisa luba sekwephuzile.
FertilityWindow.17: Izimpawu eziningana, ezibonwa ndawonye, zisiza ukukhomba kangcono lesi sikhathi:
FertilityWindow.23: Ukuhlanganisa izimpawu eziningana (umjikelezo, i-mucus, ubushisa) kunikeza isithombe esithembekile sesikhathi sakho sokuzala kunanoma yisiphi isimpawu esisodwa.

FiqhWomenIntro.6: Ukubuka okuphelele kwezihloko eziyinhloko ezimbozwe yi-fiqh yabesifazane, phakathi kwenkolo nempilo yansuku zonke.
FiqhWomenIntro.8: Lokhu okuqukethwe kungokokufundisa kuphela. Imibuzo yenkolo kufanele iqinisekiswe ngabantu abafundile abafanelekile. I-AWA ayikhishi ama-fatwa noma izinqumo zenkolo ezikuphathelene wena.
FiqhWomenIntro.17: I-fiqh yabesifazane yinkundla yomthetho wenkolo ye-Islam (fiqh) ephathelene nemibuzo esebenzayo ehlobene nemizimba yabesifazane nokukhonza. Isiza ukuqonda ukuthi ungayihlanganisa kanjani impilo yenkolo yansuku zonke nezigaba ezahlukene zomjikelezo wesifazane.
FiqhWomenIntro.27: I-fiqh iyinkundla yencazelo yomthetho: eminye imibuzo inemibono ehlukile kuye ngezazi nezikole zokucabanga, ngaphandle kokuba nomunye umbono oyiphelele ngokwawo.
FiqhWomenIntro.28: Ukuqonda i-fiqh yabesifazane kuvumela ukuphila inkolo ngokuthula okwengeziwe, ngaphandle kokudideka, ngezikhathi lapho umzimba udlula ezigabeni ezithile (isikhathi, ukukhulelwa, ngemva kokubeletha, i-menopause). Isiza futhi ukuhlukanisa lokho okungumthwalo, ukukhululwa, noma isincomo esilula.
FiqhWomenIntro.30: Ukwazi lokho okulindelwe esigabeni ngasinye somjikelezo kuvumela ukusondela enkolweni ngokuzethemba okwengeziwe.
FiqhWomenIntro.31: I-madhab ichaza isikole sokucabanga komthetho, okungukuthi indlela eyakhiwe izazi ezisebenzisa ukuze zichaze imithombo yenkolo (iQuran, iSunnah, ukuvumelana, ukucabanga) futhi zidule imibuzo esebenzayo yempilo yansuku zonke. Izikole eziningana ziyakhona, ngoba izazi azihlali zilandela indlela efanayo noma zichaze imibhalo efanayo ngendlela efanayo.
FiqhWomenIntro.32: Yingakho eminye imibuzo ehlobene nesikhathi, ukuhlanzeka kwenkolo, umkhuleko, noma ukuzila ingaba nemibono ehlukile kuye ngezazi ezibuzwayo. Umehluko womqondo akusho ukuthi omunye umbono “awulungile”: ubonisa izindlela ezahlukene nokufundwa okuhlukile komthombo ofanayo.
FiqhWomenIntro.34: Kujwayelekile ukulandela indlela noma i-madhab elandelwa ngokwesiko emndenini noma emphakathini wakho.
FiqhWomenIntro.36: Lapho isimo esithile senkolo sihlala singaqinisekile, kufanelekile ngokuphelele ukucela umbono wesazi sezenkolo esifanelekile.
FiqhWomenIntro.37: Ulwazi lwezokwelapha mayelana nomjikelezo (ubude, izimpawu, izigaba zama-hormone) nemithetho yenkolo ehambisana nalo (ukuhlanzeka, umkhuleko, ukuzila) kuphendula ezinqubweni ezimbili ezahlukene: eyodwa ichaza into yemvelo, enye ichaza uhlaka lokwenziwa kwenhliziyo. Zombili zingaphelelisana, kodwa akufanele zididaniswe.
FiqhWomenIntro.39: Ukulandelela kwezokwelapha kwomjikelezo nezimpawu zenkolo ezilandelayo kunikeza ukuqonda okuwusizo ngakunye.
FiqhWomenIntro.41: Uchwepheshe wezempilo angaphendula imibuzo yezokwelapha; isazi sezenkolo esifanelekile sihlala siyisimiso semibuzo yenkolo.
FiqhWomenIntro.42: I-AWA isekela abasebenzisi ekuqondeni umjikelezo wabo, ekuhlanganeni kwempilo nenkolo, ngendlela yokufundisa ehlonipha umehluko phakathi kwezikole.
FiqhWomenIntro.44: Qonda kangcono umjikelezo womuntu, kokubili ngokwezokwelapha nangokwenkolo
FiqhWomenIntro.45: Khomba imibuzo edinga umbono wesazi sezenkolo esifanelekile
FiqhWomenIntro.46: Zihambele phakathi kokungafani kwama-madhahib ngaphandle kokudideka
FiqhWomenIntro.47: Thola izincazelo zokufundisa ezicacile nezingathathi hlangothi
FiqhWomenIntro.49: Landelela ulwazi oluwusizo ekwenzeni kwenkolo, uma kudingeka
FiqhWomenIntro.50: Lungiselela imibuzo ethile okufanele ubuze isazi sezenkolo esifanelekile
FiqhWomenIntro.52: I-AWA iyithuluzi lokufundisa nolwazi: ayithathi indawo, kunoma yiluphi uhlobo, yombono wesazi sezenkolo esifanelekile noma ukuphatha kwenkolo.
FiqhWomenIntro.53: Ezinye izimo zifanele ukuphakanyiswa ngqo kusazi sezenkolo othembekile, ikakhulukazi lapho:
FiqhWomenIntro.54: Isimo somuntu siqu singafani nanoma yisiphi isimo esijwayelekile (ukopha okungajwayelekile, ukungabaza isikhathi eside...)
FiqhWomenIntro.55: Imibono eminingana ibonakala ephikisana futhi awazi ukuthi ulandela muphi
FiqhWomenIntro.56: Isinqumo senkolo sinomthelela omkhulu ekwenzeni kwakho kwansuku zonke
FiqhWomenIntro.57: Uzwa isidingo sesiqondiso esifanele isimo sakho siqu
FiqhWomenIntro.59: I-fiqh yabesifazane iyinkundla yencazelo ephilayo, enemibono ehlukile ngezinye izikhathi phakathi kwezikole. I-AWA ikusiza uqonde izisekelo futhi uhlele imibuzo yakho, kodwa umbono wesazi sezenkolo esifanelekile uhlala uyisimiso sanoma yisiphi isinqumo senkolo siqu.

FirstPeriod.14: Imvamisa sifika phakathi kweminyaka eyi-10 neyi-15, cishe iminyaka emibili ngemva kwezimpawu zokuqala zokuthomba.
FirstPeriod.16: Ekuqaleni, imijikelezo ingase ibe ngahleleki, imfushane, noma mide. Umzimba wakho uthatha nje isikhathi ukuthola isigqi sawo.
FirstPeriod.18: Izikhathi imvamisa zihlala izinsuku ezi-3 kuya kwezi-7. Ukuphuma kwegazi nombala kungashintsha usuku nosuku.
FirstPeriod.20: Shintsha ukuvikela kwakho njalo, geza kahle, futhi ukhethe izingubo ezikhululekile ukuze uzizwe ukhululekile.
FirstPeriod.22: Ungakhuluma nonyoko, udadewenu, umuntu osondelene nawe, uthisha, noma uchwepheshe wezempilo omthembayo.
FirstPeriod.24: Umjikelezo ongahleleki ekuqaleni ujwayelekile ngokuphelele. Umzimba wakho usafunda ukuthola isigqi sawo.
FirstPeriod.26: Umzimba ngamunye uhlukile. Thatha isikhathi sakho, ube nesineke, futhi ungabazi ukucela usizo kumuntu omthembayo.
FirstPeriod.28: Isikhathi sakho sokuqala: okufanele ukulindele · AWA

FirstPeriodComing.1:
Ngazi kanjani ukuthi
isikhathi sami sokuqala siyeza?
FirstPeriodComing.6: Izimpawu ezimbalwa ezibambekayo zingakusiza ukubona ukuthi isikhathi sakho sokuqala siyeza ngempela.
FirstPeriodComing.13: Uketshezi olulula, olucacile imvamisa luvela izinyanga ezimbalwa ngaphambili.
FirstPeriodComing.15: Uphawu oluvamile imvamisa oluvela kudala ngaphambi kwesikhathi sakho.
FirstPeriodComing.17: Imizwa emincane enjalo ingaveza ukuthi isikhathi sakho siyeza maduze.
FirstPeriodComing.18: Ngaphambi kokuba isikhathi sakho sokuqala sifike, kujwayelekile ukubona uketshezi olumhlophe noma olungasha oluhlaza emnyango womzimba wangaphansi. Lokhu kuyinto ejwayelekile, ehlobene nomsebenzi wama-hormone oqala emzimbeni wakho.
FirstPeriodComing.19: Uketshezi lwangasese lucacile noma lumhlophe, lungenawo umnuko onamandla. Igazi lesikhathi, ngakolunye uhlangothi, libomvu kuya kubhrawuni futhi lisho ukuqala kweqiniso kwesikhathi sakho. Uma ungaqiniseki, akukaze kube yinto enkulu ukukhuluma ngakho.
FirstPeriodComing.21: Ayikho indlela yokubikezela usuku oluqondile. Ukuhlala nokuvikela nawe kusukela ezimpawini zokuqala kungumkhuba ongcono kakhulu.
FirstPeriodComing.22: Ngokushesha lapho ubona lezi zimpawu, noma noma nini lapho unombuzo noma ukukhathazeka, ungakhuluma nonyoko, udadewenu, umuntu osondelene nawe, noma uchwepheshe wezempilo omthembayo. Akukaze kube nesikhathi esingalungile sokucela usizo.
FirstPeriodComing.26: Ukhetha muphi uvikelo esikhathini sami sokuqala?
FirstPeriodComing.30: Ngazi kanjani ukuthi isikhathi sami sokuqala siyeza? — AWA

FirstPeriodDailyLife.1:
Ngiphatha kanjani
isikhathi sami sokuqala nsuku zonke?
FirstPeriodDailyLife.6: Ngemikhuba embalwa emincane, isikhathi sakho sokuqala singena kalula empilweni yakho yansuku zonke, esikoleni nakwenye indawo.
FirstPeriodDailyLife.11: Isikole, ezemidlalo, ukulala: isikhathi sakho asikuvimbeli ukuqhubeka nemisebenzi yakho ejwayelekile. Udinga nje ukulungisa eminye imikhuba ukuze uhlale ukhululekile usuku lonke.
FirstPeriodDailyLife.12: Isikole noma imisebenzi: gcina i-pad noma i-tampon esikhwameni sakho
FirstPeriodDailyLife.13: Ezemidlalo: ungasadlala, nje lungisa isivinini sakho
FirstPeriodDailyLife.15: Isikhwama esincane esine-pad noma ama-tampon amabili, ingubo yangaphansi eyengeziwe, namanyela ambalwa singangena kalula esikhwameni sesikole noma sezemidlalo. Sikusiza uzizwe ukhululekile noma yini eyenzekayo.
FirstPeriodDailyLife.17: Ukuhlala unayo i-pad noma i-tampon kugwema ukucindezeleka kokubanjwa ungazilungisile.
FirstPeriodDailyLife.18: Lokhu kwenzeka kaningi, ikakhulukazi ekuqaleni. Umhlengikazi wesikole, uthisha, noma umngane cishe njalo unalokho okungasiza. Ukubophela ingubo okhalweni nakho kungasebenza ngenkathi uthola i-pad noma i-tampon.
FirstPeriodDailyLife.20: Ngikhetha iyiphi i-pad noma i-tampon esikhathini sami sokuqala?
FirstPeriodDailyLife.24: Izikhathi zami zokuqala aziyohleleki: ingabe lokhu kujwayelekile?
FirstPeriodDailyLife.26: Ngiphatha kanjani isikhathi sami sokuqala nsuku zonke? — AWA

FirstPeriodFaq.1:
Imibuzo evame ukubuzwa
ngesikhathi sakho sokuqala
FirstPeriodFaq.6: Imiphendulo elula yemibuzo evame kakhulu ngesikhathi sakho sokuqala.
FirstPeriodFaq.9: Yebo. Imijikelezo yokuqala imvamisa inegazi elincane. Ukuphuma kwegazi kungahluka kumjikelezo nomjikelezo, ikakhulukazi ekuqaleni.
FirstPeriodFaq.11: Igazi eliningi nalo lingenzeka, ikakhulukazi ezinsukwini ezimbili zokuqala. Uma udinga ukushintsha ukuvikela kwakho ngaphezu kwanye ngehora amahora amaningana alandelanayo, kuhle ukukhuluma nochwepheshe wezempilo ngakho.
FirstPeriodFaq.13: Ubuhlungu obuncane esiswini esingaphansi buvamile futhi imvamisa abukhathazi. Ibhodlela lamanzi ashisayo noma ukuphumula okuncane kungasiza. Ubuhlungu obukhulu kakhulu bufanele ukutshelwa umuntu.
FirstPeriodFaq.15: Yebo, ungasadlala ezemidlalo ngesikhathi sakho. Nje lungisa izinga ngokwendlela umzimba wakho ozizwa ngayo ngalolo suku.
FirstPeriodFaq.17: Yebo, ungasabhukuda ngokuvikela okufanele. Abantu abaningi bakhetha nje ukulinda kuze kube yilapho bezizwa bekhululekile ngomqondo.
FirstPeriodFaq.19: Akukho umbuzo ongajabulisi: umzimba ngamunye uhlukile, futhi ungahlala ukhuluma nomuntu omthembayo.
FirstPeriodFaq.23: Ukhetha muphi uvikelo esikhathini sami sokuqala?
